payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 9:1–9 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states after Solomon’s prayer, God says his name and eyes will be at the house while attaching continued dwelling to covenant conduct. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
